scenario: a misunderstanding or problem involving health services & pharmacy
english_title: Recognising and Responding to a Misunderstanding or Problem Involving Health Services and Pharmacy
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: health services & pharmacy — a misunderstanding or problem involving health services & pharmacy
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to a misunderstanding or problem involving health services & pharmacy; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan tells Mr Thomas she thinks this is the wrong medicine.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan nói với anh Thomas hình như đây nhầm thuốc.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Excuse me, Thomas. I think this is the wrong medicine.
turns.vietnamese: Xin lỗi anh Thomas. Hình như đây nhầm thuốc rồi.

turns.speaker: Mr Thomas
turns.english: Oh, let me check that immediately.
turns.vietnamese: Ồ, để tôi kiểm tra ngay.

turns.speaker: Mr Thomas
turns.english: I am very sorry about that.
turns.vietnamese: Tôi thật sự xin lỗi về chuyện đó.
